board_side.grounding: Board oversight via the audit committee under SOX 301 / Part 363; SOX 302 binds the certifying officers, not the board.
board_side.object: oversight of the CEO/CFO certification process via the audit committee

management_side.actor: CEO and CFO (principal executive and financial officers)
management_side.note: SOX 302 certification verb lives on the management actor, not the board.
management_side.verb_evidence: must include certifications in the form specified in the applicable exhibit filing requirements of such report and such certifications must be filed as an exhibit

rationale: REVIEW_PACKET_B3 Part 2 — SOX 302 (17 CFR 240.13a-14) binds the certifying officers, not the board; the board-side residual is audit-committee oversight of the certification process (review_and_challenge), grounded in SOX 301 / Part 363, not SOX 302.
